# Alternative final stores followed by a branch-tail loop

This independently authored witness extends the existing owned final-branch
corpus. Both constructor arms commit the same final array field; one arm then
loops and calls opaque producers. Frozen observers see allocation defaults,
the committed reference during every producer/loop step, partial arrays,
mutations, late loads and exact checked/Error identity through direct,
reflection and method-handle constructor calls. The field remains final in
source and bytecode. Every source and SDK output compiles with definitions,
metadata, roles and Exceptions compared. No private application data is used.
